title: Satoshi’s Last Email… Then He Vanished 👻 #Shorts
description:
Satoshi Nakamoto's last public forum post was in December 2010.
On April 23, 2011 he emailed developer Mike Hearn: "I've moved on to other things. It's in good hands with Gavin and everyone."
Around the same time he wrote to Gavin Andresen: "I wish you wouldn't keep talking about me as a mysterious shadowy figure, the press just turns that into a pirate currency angle."
On April 27, 2011 Gavin announced he would talk about Bitcoin at the CIA. Gavin later said: "The last email I sent him, I actually told him I was going to talk at the CIA."
Satoshi is believed to hold about a million Bitcoin that have never moved.

Coincidence? 👇

Not financial advice. Entertainment and education only.
pinned: Why do YOU think Satoshi disappeared? 👇
